digest.component_or_area: CLI command parsing and help system
propositions: Command parsing is split across multiple mechanisms (argparse, imperative argv loops, hand-maintained help files, intercepted descriptions), causing drift between runtime behavior and documentation.
Parser migrations must capture production-path oracles (positive/negative argv, diagnostics, exit codes, streams) before switching handlers atomically to prevent unapproved behavior deltas.
Generated help and overview artifacts must be byte-deterministic, regenerable via factory methods, and served before operation/config/store/handler boundaries with exact alias reuse.
All registered command grammars must be produced by a single side-effect-free argparse factory with no duplicate parsing, regex-based extraction, or secondary frameworks remaining.
Registry validation must reject duplicate spellings, contradictory policy, unknown capabilities, missing parser references, and stray generated resources without importing handlers during startup.
